title: QC-HOME-013 — About Us Section & Last Year Achievements Counters

QC-HOME-013 —
About Us Section & Last Year Achievements Counters
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-HOME-013 | US001 | REF:
FR-004
Title
About Us Section — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to view the About Qatar Chamber section on the Home Page
with building images, description, and achievements counters
So that
I can learn about Qatar Chamber's history, role, and key
achievements
Preconditions:
- The About Us section is published and active in the
CMS.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor scrolls to the About Us section on the Home Page.
2. The section renders: building image composition on the
left with the Years of Experience badge; section tag, heading/Title, and
description text on the right.
3. Below the heading area a Last Year Achievement’s counter
block displays with icon, animated count, and label for each counter.
4. Visitor clicks the Read More CTA — browser redirects to
the About Us page.
5. The section is fully responsive on all screen sizes.
Given the visitor
scrolls to the About Us section
When the
section renders
Then
- The system shall display the building image composition
with the Dynamic text “Years of Experience” badge overlaid.
- The system shall display the section tag, heading, and
rich text description in the active language.
- The system shall display the Read More CTA; clicking it
shall redirect the visitor to the About Us page.
- The system shall display the achievements counter block
with icon, animated numeric count, and counter label for each active counter
item.
- The section shall be fully responsive on all screen
sizes.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If the About Us page is unpublished the Read More
button shall not navigate to an invalid page.
Post Condition:
- Visitor can read about Qatar Chamber and view key
achievement stats on the Home Page.
BACKEND — Admin CMS
Management
User Story ID
QC-HOME-013 | US002 | REF: FR-004
Title
About Us Section — CMS Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to manage the About Us section on the Home Page including
content, building images, years of experience badge, and achievements
counters in Liferay CMS
So that
visitors see an accurate and current About Qatar Chamber
section on the Home Page
Preconditions:
- Admin user has the appropriate role to manage Home Page
content in Liferay CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Home Page → About Us Section Management.
3. Enters the section tag, heading, and description
(bilingual).
4. Uploads building images for the visual collage.
5. Enters the Years of Experience badge text (bilingual).
6. Configures the Read More CTA label and URL (bilingual).
7. Configures achievement counters: title (bilingual),
numeric value, icon image, display order, active status.
8. Saves as draft, previews, and publishes the section.
9. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
10. Published configuration reflects on the Home Page after
cache refresh.
Given the admin
opens About Us Section management in the CMS
When the admin
configures and publishes the section
Then
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the
section tag, heading, and description (bilingual).
- The system shall allow the admin to upload one or more
building images for the visual collage.
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the years
of experience badge text (bilingual).
- The system shall allow the admin to configure the read
more CTA label and redirect URL (bilingual).
- The system shall allow the admin to manage achievement
counter items: title (bilingual), numeric value, icon image, display order, and
active status and the user would be able to add maximum 4 badges same as showing in the figma.
- The system shall allow draft, submit for review,
publish, and unpublish actions.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful action.
Negative Scenarios:
- If mandatory fields are skipped: "{Field Name} is
required." {اسم الحقل} مطلوب.
- If the Read More URL is invalid: "Please enter a
valid URL." يرجى إدخال رابط صالح.
Post Condition:
- The About Us section is published and displayed
correctly on the Home Page.
